scenes.say: Crusty, itchy eyelashes every morning? Your eyelids need cleaning too.

scenes.en: Tiny oil glands line your eyelids. When they block, oil and flakes build up.
scenes.ta: இமை ஓரத்தில் சிறிய எண்ணெய் சுரப்பிகள் உள்ளன
scenes.say: Your eyelids have tiny oil glands along the edge. This oil stops tears drying too fast. When the glands get blocked, oil and flakes build up at the lashes.

scenes.en: Eyelid inflammation is very common. Daily care keeps it in check.
scenes.say: Did you know? Eyelid inflammation is very common. It often comes and goes, and simple daily care helps keep it under control.

scenes.en: Wash your hands before touching your eyes.
scenes.say: Do wash your hands with soap before you touch your eyes.

scenes.en: Clean cloth, warm (not hot) water, eyes closed, 5 to 10 minutes.
scenes.say: Do place a clean cloth, dipped in warm, not hot, water, over your closed eyes for five to ten minutes. This softens the oil.

scenes.en: Wipe along the lash line with a clean, damp cotton pad.
scenes.ta: இமை ஓரத்தை ஈரமான பஞ்சால் மெதுவாக துடையுங்கள்
scenes.say: Then gently wipe along the lash line with a clean, damp cotton pad. Use a fresh pad for each eye.

scenes.en: Don't rub, pick the crusts, or sleep in eye makeup.
scenes.say: Don't rub your eyes, don't pick at the crusts, and never sleep with eye makeup on.

scenes.en: Pain, swelling, a lump or blurred vision.
scenes.ta: வலி, வீக்கம், கட்டி இருந்தால் கண் மருத்துவரை பாருங்கள்
scenes.say: See an eye specialist if you have pain, swelling, a lump, or blurred vision. Book an eye test today.
